title: Dramatic Coastal Blowholes and Ocean Waves
place: Tropical rocky coast with blowholes (location not given on page)
people: two far, tiny figures (faces not identifiable) on the grass at x~0.2, ~1-7 s; none in 9-13 s
notes: Drone flying in over a rock shelf toward a palm-fringed meadow. 0-2 s: waves crash into the shelf and spray at the cliff base (x~0.4-0.7, y~0.5-0.7). 2-4.5 s: thin white spouts shoot up through the rock (x~0.45-0.5, y~0.2-0.4; second spout x~0.35 at 3-4 s). 5-9 s: drone passes over the shelf (lull). 9.3-12 s: drone reaches a blowhole as a big spout erupts right in front of the camera, filling the centre (x~0.4-0.6, full height) and spraying the lens at 11.5-13 s. PEOPLE: two small figures in swimwear stand on the grass ~1-7 s at x~0.2-0.25, y~0.15-0.3 (far, ~30-50 px tall, faces not identifiable) - a 0.72-aspect crop centred at x~0.5 keeps them out; distant cars on a road (no readable logos). Shot A 2.0-4.6 s (crop centre x~0.5), Shot B 9.3-12.0 s (no people).
